entries.summary: Make solar power practical and restore rewarding classic lab and LMOE exploration.
details: Solar panels retain irradiance-based output at a 90 W base rating, and the irradiator again contains a rare compact ASRG.
Classic labs and ordinary LMOEs are more discoverable on newly generated overmaps, with targeted guaranteed rewards.

entries.summary: Restore rare military turret sites as dangerous, damaged, partially loaded salvage encounters.
details: Military roadblocks and outposts can field damaged rifle or heavy-weapon turrets with sharply limited ammunition.
Police encounters and turret combat statistics remain unchanged.
